images.title: Apache basketry
images.caption: Storage basket, ca. 1890. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Diker Collection; gift of Charles and Valerie Diker, 2019.
images.photoCredit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art; individual photographer unrecorded
images.altText: A rounded Apache storage basket with a narrow neck, woven in golden and dark fibers with horizontal bands, geometric shapes, and small human and animal figures.
